primary_market: Commercial and managed properties responsible for valuable palm portfolios.
secondary_market: Residential and estate owners responsible for valuable mature palms.
canonical_position: Mature palms help define a property. Their care deserves someone who knows each palm, keeps its history and takes responsibility for the next conversation. I give management one accountable point of contact for the agreed work.
homepage_headline: Preventive Treatment for San Diego’s Most Valuable Palms
homepage_supporting_copy: A mature palm took decades to become part of your landscape. I believe its care deserves a plan and someone who knows it. I’m John Krause in Old Escondido. I provide South American palm weevil (SAPW) prevention and licensed treatment for mature Canary Island date palms across San Diego County, do the work myself and stay in touch between visits.
stewardship_distinction: A treatment schedule is a start. Someone still needs to notice when the palm changes.
differentiators: South American palm weevil specialization, led by mature Canary Island date palms and extending to high-value Chilean wine and Bismarck palms
Direct owner involvement from walkthrough through follow-up
